brief.empty_all: Nothing on the list yet. Say: "chase <the thing>" - and I will take it and keep at it.
brief.night: Night window %02d:00-%02d:00: I am not writing to anyone now, I will send in the morning.
brief.nothing_for_you: nothing - you do not have to do anything right now
brief.out_of_attempts: attempts used up, I am handing it over
brief.updated: Updated %s (chasecall:brief). This file is rewritten every time; nothing else in the folder is touched.
brief.ask: I can leave this brief in that folder as a file, so you can read it on your phone. It has the names of your tasks in it, who you are chasing, the phone numbers and the notes. That folder goes to your cloud - Google Drive or Dropbox - so the file goes there too. Shall I?
brief.not_agreed: nothing was written: nobody has said yes to leaving the brief in %s, and it travels to the cloud from there
brief.ask_how: ask the person the question above, in their own words, and run the same command with --agreed on a yes, or with --declined on a no
brief.declined: the brief is not left in %s: the person said no. Nothing was written.
brief.occupied: there is already a file called %s in %s and it is not ours. It was left exactly as it is and nothing was written - ask the person what that file is, or use another folder.
brief.occupied_again: the file called %s in %s is not the one we wrote: our brief is gone from there and somebody else's file is under that name now. It was left exactly as it is and nothing was written - ask the person what that file is, or use another folder.
brief.no_folder: say which folder the brief should be left in
brief.not_here: the folder %s is not on this computer right now; the brief was not written

inbox.no_folder_yet: No folder from the phone has been named yet.
inbox.folder_not_here: - it is not on this computer right now
inbox.folder_gone: The folder %s is not on this computer right now, so there is nothing to look at.
inbox.arriving: not all of it is here yet - it will be whole next time
inbox.shown_before: %d more were shown earlier and are still not sorted.
inbox.pending_of_all: %d of them are not sorted yet.
inbox.marked: Written down as sorted: %s. The file itself was not touched.
inbox.moved: %s now lies in the %s folder inside the same folder. Nothing was deleted.
inbox.moved_renamed: %s now lies in the %s folder inside the same folder, under the name %s: a file of the first name was already there, and both are still here.
inbox.already_done: %s was already in the %s folder; only the note was written down.
inbox.need_folder: Say which folder both the phone and this computer can see.
inbox.no_folder_set: No folder from the phone has been named yet.
inbox.too_high: I will not take %s: that is the home folder or a folder at the very top, with everything you own inside it. Name the one folder in Google Drive or Dropbox that you share things into from the phone - a folder of its own, inside them.
inbox.crowded: %s already holds %d things, and nothing new from the street would be visible among them. If this is not the folder you share into from the phone, name that one instead. If it is the right one, the things you have already dealt with can move into the done folder inside it - I do that after your yes - or you can put them away into folders of your own by hand; then name it again.
inbox.not_a_folder: %s is a file, not a folder.
inbox.no_such_file: There is no file called %s in the folder from the phone.
inbox.outside: %s is not in the folder from the phone. That one folder is the only place I touch, so I am not moving it.
inbox.bad_into: A sorted file goes into %s and nowhere else.
inbox.move_failed: %s could not be moved: %s. Nothing was lost; it is where it was.

routine.how_to:
Background is already in Claude Code, and it is the one that works:
  1. Open the Claude app -> the Code tab.
  2. Routines -> New routine -> Local.
  3. Pick how often: Hourly / Daily / Weekdays / Weekly.
  4. Paste the prompt from `routine.py prompt` and save.
It runs while the app is open and the computer is awake; one missed run is caught up afterwards.
You can also just say in the chat: "check my tasks every morning at nine".
routine.no_claude: I do not see `claude` in PATH, so I will not set up a background run - your tasks will come back to life in your next session, and nothing is lost.
routine.mac_no_install: On macOS I install nothing by myself: a background job put in with launchd is cut off by the system's privacy protection the moment it touches your files, and you would think you were being helped when you were not. Use the Routine above - it really runs.
routine.not_windows: this is for Windows; on %s the Routine in the Code tab is the one that works

tracker.busy: the task file is busy right now - something else is writing to it. Nothing was changed; try again in a moment.
tracker.unwritable: the task file %s cannot be written to - the permissions on it do not allow it. Nothing was changed, and this one will not pass by itself.
tracker.not_ours: %s is not a Chasecall task file - nothing was read from it and nothing was written to it. Move it aside, or say where the real one is.

yes_unnamed.money: <this one amount, to this one shop>
